If the data related to the production of type R motorcycles is represented by Pie-Chart, then the central angle of the sector representing the production of motorcycles in 2020 will be:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total production of motorcycle R in 4 years = 65 + 37 + 50 + 28 = 180

Required degree = (50/180) × 360° = 100°.

**∴ The required answer is 100°.**
